title: A risky write waits for a person's click, and only the stored call runs, once
aria: The model asks for mark_paid. Code checks a constant confirm list: reads and four adds run at once, while 31 tools are checked against the stored bill, saved as a proposal that expires in 10 minutes, and shown to the person as a card built from stored data. The click is a new request that sends only a reference; the server checks owner, expiry and single use, runs exactly the stored call with the version checked again, and gives the model the result under its own call id.

build.title: The model only asks
build.text: The model, Gemini Flash in Billpod, runs no code. It asks for a tool call. A confirm list in code, `CONFIRM_TOOLS`, decides what happens next. No text the model reads can change it.

build.title: Reads and adds run at once
build.text: A tool not on the list runs in the same request: 11 reads and 4 adds. The result goes back to the model at once. `add_bill` gets an Undo button.

build.title: A risky write becomes a card
build.text: 31 of the 46 tools need a yes. Code checks the call against the stored bill, then draws a card from stored data, never the model's words. The proposal is saved for 10 minutes and the turn ends.

build.title: The click is a new request
build.text: The click sends only a row id and the decision. The server checks user, expiry and single use (400, 410, 409). It runs exactly the stored call with `WHERE version = 3` and gives the model the result under c2.

build.title: Ask only where it matters
build.text: Claude Code users approve 93% of prompts, so a card on every call is a weak check. An injected add still runs at once, and Undo is its only defence.

route.title: Let the harmless read run at once
route.text: The model asks for `find_bills`. Reading changes nothing, so it runs at once. The bill goes back with its version: b17, CHF 84.20, version 3.

route.title: Hold the risky write instead of running it
route.text: The model asks for `mark_paid` with b17, version 3 and card, under call id c2. `mark_paid` is on the confirm list, a constant in code, so it does not run.

route.title: Check the change can happen before asking anyone
route.text: Code checks that the bill exists, is at version 3 and is unpaid. A call that would fail goes back to the model at once, with no card.

route.title: Code draws the card from the stored bill
route.text: Payee and amount come from the stored bill: City Power AG, CHF 84.20. The proposal is saved with an expiry and the chat request ends. Billpod seals it in a token instead, valid 10 minutes.

route.title: The click sends only the row id and the decision
route.text: The server runs only what it stored, for the user it was made for, once. Billpod: a changed token gets 400, an expired one 410, a second answer 409.

route.title: Run exactly the stored call, checking the version again
route.text: The write runs `WHERE version = 3`: 1 row updated. If the bill had changed, 0 rows, and that refusal goes to the model. Either way, the card is used up.

route.title: Give the model its answer under its own call id
route.text: The click's request loads the stored chat, adds the result under c2 and asks the model again. It replies "Done: marked paid." On Cancel, the model gets a declined result under c2.
